gaze.name: gaze-estimation-adas-0002
gaze.license: Apache-2.0 as referenced by official model.yml

preprocessing.inputs: two 60x60 eye crops and yaw/pitch/roll [1,3] degrees
preprocessing.eye_crop: OMZ35 corner pairs 0/1 and 2/3; square side 1.8*corner distance; reject outside/too-small crops
preprocessing.roll_alignment: warp each eye around integer center with roll degrees and BORDER_REPLICATE; supply head roll=0; compensate vector rotation afterward

gaze.output_semantics: Normalize gaze vector, undo roll, then use OMZ demo yaw=90+atan2(z,x) wrapped to [-180,180), pitch=asin(y/norm), both in degrees. Zero yaw follows model -Z. No calibrated camera/world ray is claimed.
